messages:
maggie: Quick item for the roadmap: propose we add telemetry-driven pricing guardrails. Idea: automated "safety" actions when negotiated overrides or addon changes materially erode margin or predict churn. Need concise runbook + launch gates.

kim: interesting. We should be careful — automation can trigger on noisy signals. Recommend human-in-loop for first 90 days. Define exact metrics and thresholds before automation.

jess: metrics we need: margin_delta_pct (7d rolling), discount_burn_rate (discount % * run-rate), churn_risk_score, override_frequency. Also surface customer size + contract terms.

owen: infra note: implement in 3 phases: (1) simulation mode (Console shows what would have happened), (2) soft enforcement (alerts + manual review), (3) hard enforcement (auto-rollback / billing block). Each phase gated by telemetry stability checks.

revops-bot: ticket created: #9909 "Telemetry pricing automation: metrics, sim mode, rollback rules" assignees: jess, owen, kim. ETA 2025-08-01.

legal-bot: Legal: any auto-change that affects billing requires prior notice in contract or an amendment. Auto-rollback of discounts is OK if we give customers X days notice and a dispute channel. I'll draft clause (and a short customer notice template).

sales-bot: created ticket #9910 "Sales enablement: telemetry guardrails one-pager + dispute playbook" assignees: sales-eng. ETA 2025-07-15.

maggie: Launch gating I propose: (a) simulation mode run for 4 weeks across a 1% customer sample with realtime dashboard; (b) error/false-positive rate <2% and no material revenue impact in simulation; (c) legal amendment + dispute flow in place; (d) sales enablement + communication templates ready.

kim: add a rollback dry-run that notifies customers 7 days before any auto-rollback would run. That gives Sales time to intervene.

jess: agree. We'll also track post-action signals: churn within 30/90 days and support ticket volume. Important for tuning thresholds.

owen: tech constraints: need request-level model + precision logged, billing CU field, streaming alert pipeline, and an audit log of any automated action. I'll break into infra subtasks in #9909.

legal-bot: I'll keep the notice window conservative: 7 days for soft actions, 30 days for permanent price changes. That matches earlier policy.

maggie: Owners: jess -> metrics spec + simulation dashboard, owen -> infra + audit log, kim -> human-approval workflow + evaluation plan, legal-bot -> notice & clause, revops-bot -> ticket tracking, sales-bot -> enablement. I'll add a short paragraph to the roadmap reflecting telemetry-driven guardrails and a pilot start date. Merge if no objections.

kim: no objections from me.

jess: LGTM.

owen: fine from eng.

maggie: scheduling 30m demo for next Tues to walk through dashboard mockups.
